units: <cite ref="Berakhot 20a:6">Ber. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>דמיין … כי ק׳ חיורי</he> they are in my sight like white geese (exciting no sexual desires).

<cite ref="Gittin 73a:18">Gitt. 73ᵃ</cite> (of unjust scholars) <he>ק׳ חיורי דמשלחי וכ׳</he> white geese (old men) that strip men of their cloaks; <cite ref="Ketubot 85a:3">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite>.—[Ar. reads: <he>קָקֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="S01859"><he>קָקָא</he></cite>.]
